text: oh cool. i found it. ok. so, first things first. camera is backwards on zoom for the scroll so fix that. second, the grid space, we want to have a clean 9 segment grid where there is only grid lines in the center tile space. like so [Image #17]
resolution: Four Studio viewport fixes after the user's first eyeball, all hot-reloadable TSX in editors/model/Studio.tsx (bundle-verified): (1) flipped scroll-zoom direction (wheel up = zoom in); (2) rebuilt the ground grid into a clean 9-segment 3x3 floor (1 big tile = 1 game tile = tileMeters; total = one floor) with the fine subdivision ONLY in the center tile, matching the user's reference image — gridTiles/tileMeters/fineDivisions are registered STUDIO tunables; (3) fixed the fov control breakage by replacing GAME_CHROME.Knob (its spec shape differs from the purpose-built zoomSpec VoxelStage feeds it) with robust -/+ steppers; (4) removed the camera floor — camera.zig's orbit solve has no ground clamp, the floor was the local +-85deg pitch limit, widened to +-89.9deg so the user can orbit directly under and over the part. Pending the user's next eyeball.
